def checkDivisibility(W, M):
    if M == 1:
        return True
    if M % W == 0:
        return checkDivisibility(W, M // W)
    elif (M - 1) % W == 0:
        return checkDivisibility(W, (M - 1) // W)
    elif (M + 1) % W == 0:

    return False
